TRIGGER.TITLE: Activation trigger
TRIGGER.SUBTITLE: Choose which channel and when this flow starts. Without a trigger the bot never runs.
TRIGGER.KEYWORD_HINT: Fires when the message contains any of these words.
TRIGGER.RUN_HINT: POST { conversation_id } to this URL to start the flow.

ON_FIRST_MESSAGE.LABEL: First message
ON_FIRST_MESSAGE.HINT: Starts on the customer's first message in the conversation.

KEYWORD.LABEL: Keyword
KEYWORD.HINT: Starts when the message matches one of your keywords.

ANY_MESSAGE.LABEL: Any message
ANY_MESSAGE.HINT: Starts on any incoming message when no flow is running.

WEBHOOK.LABEL: Webhook
WEBHOOK.HINT: Started by an external system calling this flow's URL.

AD_REFERRAL.LABEL: Lead from ad
AD_REFERRAL.HINT: Starts when the message comes from a Click-to-WhatsApp ad (Facebook/Instagram).

RECURRING_CUSTOMER.LABEL: Returning customer
RECURRING_CUSTOMER.HINT: Starts on the first message of a customer who already had a conversation that ended.

NO_REPLY.LABEL: Customer waiting
NO_REPLY.HINT: Starts when the customer has waited for an agent longer than the minutes below (checked every 5 minutes).

LABEL_ADDED.LABEL: Label added
LABEL_ADDED.HINT: Starts when one of the chosen labels is added to the conversation.

BROADCAST_REPLY.LABEL: Replied to a broadcast
BROADCAST_REPLY.HINT: Starts on the customer's first reply to a campaign from the last 7 days.

DATE.LABEL: Date
DATE.HINT: Birthday or X days after the appointment, a stage or the conversation. Only within sending hours.

LIST_ENTERED.LABEL: Joined a list
LIST_ENTERED.HINT: Starts when the contact joins a distribution list.

TRIGGER.NO_REPLY_HINT: Counted from the customer's last unanswered message, like the risk queue.
TRIGGER.SENDER_NAME_HINT: Shown in bold before each flow message. Leave blank for no signature.
TRIGGER.LABELS_HINT: A label applied by a running flow does not start another flow.
TRIGGER.BROADCASTS_HINT: With none selected, a reply to any broadcast counts.

DATE_KINDS.AFTER_RESOLUTION: Days after the conversation was resolved

TRIGGER.DATE_HINT: Checked every hour, Mon–Sat 9am–7pm only, at most 30 conversations per hour and once per date for each customer.
TRIGGER.PAUSE_ON_AGENT_HINT: The bot stops talking when someone on the team replies (from the dashboard or the phone). Resume it with one click in the conversation.

LIST.TITLE: Chatflow
LIST.SUBTITLE: Build guided message automations so your bot can qualify and route customers without depending on AI.
LIST.DELETE_CONFIRM: Delete the flow "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
LIST.EMPTY_BODY: Create your first chatbot flow to greet customers, show a menu and route them automatically.

NODE.ASSIGN_SUMMARY: Assign to an agent or team

EDITOR.NAME: Step name
EDITOR.MESSAGE_PLACEHOLDER: Type the message the bot will send…
EDITOR.CAPTION: Caption
EDITOR.OPTIONS_HINT: Each option becomes a connection point you link to the next step.
EDITOR.END_HINT: This step ends the automation. The conversation stays open for a human or the AI.
EDITOR.WEBHOOK_HINT: We POST the conversation + contact data to this URL.
EDITOR.SET_START: Start the flow at this step
EDITOR.CONFIRMATION_FALLBACK: When the reply is not understood
EDITOR.CONFIRMATION_FALLBACK_PLACEHOLDER: Sorry, I didn't get that. Please answer Yes or No.
EDITOR.CONFIRMATION_FALLBACK_HINT: Sent with the question again. After 2 tries the flow leaves through "not resolved".
EDITOR.FLOW_HINT: Works only on WhatsApp Cloud API inboxes. In test mode a draft form is sent; live flows need a published form.

QUESTION.KEY_HINT: name, email and phone_number are saved on the contact itself; any other key becomes a custom attribute.
QUESTION.ERROR: Message when the answer is not valid
QUESTION.ERROR_PLACEHOLDER: E.g. I didn't get the date. Reply like 25/10
QUESTION.ATTEMPTS_HINT: After the last attempt the flow leaves through “Invalid answer” (or ends, if it is not connected).

CONDITION.EMPTY: Without rules everyone goes through “Yes”. Add a rule below.

WAIT.REPLY_STOP_HINT: The reminder no longer makes sense: the team takes the conversation.
WAIT.REPLY_KEEP_HINT: Ignore the message and go on at the scheduled time.
WAIT.REPLY_BRANCH_HINT: Adds a second exit to the card to handle the reply.
WAIT.WINDOW_HINT: If the time is up outside Mon–Sat 9am–7pm, waits for the next opening (anti-ban protection).

SPLIT.HINT: Each customer goes down a path picked by the percentages. Use it to test two message versions.

GOTO.HINT: This flow ends and the other one starts on the same conversation. Only active flows (or drafts, in test mode).

TYPING.HINT: A pause before the next message so the bot doesn't reply in bursts.

LIST.UNAVAILABLE: Distribution lists are not available in this account yet. The block is ready and skipped until then.
LIST.HINT: Adding to a list also fires flows with the “Joined a list” trigger.

TEST.TITLE: Test this flow
TEST.SUBTITLE: While testing, the flow only runs for the number below.
TEST.STARTED: Test mode on. Message the bot from the tester number.

BUILDER.ACTIVATE_HINT: Set a start step before activating.

SIMULATOR.TITLE: Simulator
SIMULATOR.SAFE: Nothing is sent to the customer
SIMULATOR.ENDED_PLACEHOLDER: Flow finished — restart to test again

ERRORS.NO_START_NODE: Connect the trigger to a start step to simulate.
ERRORS.NO_INBOX: The account needs an inbox to simulate.

TEMPLATES.SUBTITLE: Ready-made flows for your business. Each template becomes a draft: review the texts, test in the simulator and only then activate it.
TEMPLATES.ERROR: Could not create the flow from the template.
TEMPLATES.DRAFT_NOTE: Templates start turned off. Nothing is sent until you activate the flow.

BOT_BANNER.PAUSED_BY: Bot paused — {name} took over the conversation
BOT_BANNER.ERROR: Could not change the bot right now.
